Networking.reason: Network tooling, service defaults and firewall behavior can drift across distro releases.

Bảo mật.reason: Security guidance, package defaults and hardening recommendations need comparatively frequent review.

Storage.reason: Storage commands are stable but filesystem, package and platform guidance can change.

Công cụ mới.reason: Tool capabilities, install methods and supported platforms change relatively quickly.

Monitoring.reason: Observability tools and output semantics evolve, while core troubleshooting concepts are moderately stable.

Automation.reason: Shell and automation guidance is durable but package, interpreter and platform behavior can drift.

Ôn tập.reason: End-to-end labs inherit the drift risk of the commands and services they combine.
